description: A hiring loop optimized for speed at the cost of fairness and signal.

flaws.description: A 4-6 hour unpaid take-home systematically filters out candidates with caregiving duties or second jobs, narrowing the pool in a way that correlates with protected characteristics.
'Team fit' decided by majority vote is a well-documented vector for affinity bias, and creates no written record of why someone was rejected.
Removing the system-design round for senior hires drops the signal most predictive of seniority, and nothing replaces it.
Two of five losses is assumed to be a speed problem; nobody asked the candidates why they declined.
Applies to all senior roles immediately with no pilot, no calibration for interviewers, and no measure of whether hire quality changed.
